description: Can an SRS repository travel inside a PDF, HTML page or Word file that people read as usual, so the document stays usable and an SRS reader also gets its provenance? Two prototypes (meeting minutes; the muSrs essay Rebuilding Small Democracy), the trust model, and what SRS needs.
name: research-srs-carriers
title: SRS carriers: provenance inside the documents people already use (2026-11-27)
